actual_scope: For q prime at least five and a,b positive, every q+3-row root-phase matrix with at least four orthogonal columns descends from mu_(3^a q^b) to mu_(3q) by row and column phases. Exact eight-row capacity is four for all a,b.
scope_change_reason: Resolve the higher-power alphabet question with a simultaneous-column rigidity argument, using the published two-prime cycle theorem and the complete fifteenth-root capacity certificate.
bottleneck_link: Determine whether enlarging these exact phase alphabets can supply additional orthogonal columns; no physical supplier or caller gain is inferred.
stop_rule: Stop after the all-power descent proof, sharp three-column boundary and exact source-bound controls pass; leave other row counts and extra prime factors explicit.
evidence: PROOF.md gives the all-power descent and sharpness. verify.py checks exact quotient patterns, cyclotomic examples and unchanged finite capacity; RESULT.json records the full checks.
